title: Athara baras ke
body:
athara baras ke ali akbar ka janaza
akbar ka janaza
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh laate hai hamshakle payambar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein alam aaya hai kohraam hai barpa
darya par hai abbas e dilawar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
is darja sakina se tha sharminda alamdaar
sheh laa na sake apne baraadar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay kul ke madadgaar madad karne ko aao
shabbir se uth'ta nahi akbar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ki taraf dehk ke ye kehti thi bano
kin aankhon se dekhun mai gul e tar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
pamaal hua dasht mein ghodon ke sumon se
kis tarha uthay qasim e muztar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
pad jaaye na ya rab kahin zainab ki nigahein
teeron pa hai rakha hua sarwar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya zulm hai tapti hui reti pa pada hai
be gor o kafan sibte payambar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab dafn hua fatema sar peet rahi thi
shabbir bin e saaqi e kausar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ne kaha teer hai paywast badan mein
dheere sa uthana mere shauhar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne kaha sar se mere chin gaye chadar
tareekh e shab mein utha maadar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab zara bano ke kaleje ko sambhalo
shabbir ke haaton pa hai asghar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
us bahi se zindan ki musibat koi pooche
jis bhai ke haaton pa ho khwahar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarwar ki sada aati hai choti si lehad se
lao mujhe de do meri dukhtar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ishrat mai bayan kaise karun kaise utha tha
maqtal ki zameen se sheh e be-sar ka janaza
athara baras ke...
author: Ishrat Lakhnavi
